interpretation.reason: System load was not controlled and CPU/thermal state was not sampled per trial; capture parity PASS does not prove isolated causal timing costs

limitations: Recorded Workspace projection; current read-only interface reports not_prepared
Fixed map sizes; unrelated Dashboard API bootstrap disabled
Render event cadence, not compositor-confirmed display frames
RSS includes shared pages; not dedicated GPU VRAM
Fresh Chrome per trial; OS and server caches are not flushed
Callback timings are inclusive and must not be summed across nested wrappers
Rudy uses existing prepared Z14 cache; native higher-zoom tiles were missing
Three trials per case; ranges and paired block differences are descriptive, not confidence intervals
All cases retain full Dashboard DOM and candidate preparation; layer ablations isolate submitted map content
Inactive/empty layers do not represent a populated workload; current structure lens contains 43 QGIS points
Native Dashboard terrain LOD is retained, not forced to full source-pixel density

measurementCaveat: 方向性結果：Mac 後段回報 CPU_Speed_Limit = 38、swap 約 5 GB；原因未確認，且沒有逐輪系統狀態紀錄。不要把全部 FPS／載入／RSS 波動歸因於某一圖層，也不要據此決定更換引擎。
findings: 先保留 MapLibre。三個區塊的配對比較中，開啟原有同步後旋轉下降 4.24–7.27 FPS、平移下降 8.40–14.18 FPS；數字仍受系統負載影響。
固定中心旋轉 12 秒時，2D jumpTo 中位數 407 次，第二張地圖仍繪製 370 次。同步 JavaScript 累計約 470 ms，還不包含後續 GPU／worker 繪製。
加入 Rudy 後旋轉的配對差值中位數為 −6.47 FPS；再加入候選圖層為 −5.14 FPS。固定不動的第二張地圖約 −0.49 FPS。山體陰影單獨成本受波動影響，未能明確分離。
完整單圖的 Dashboard DOM 建立中位數約 687 ms；QGIS 過濾被呼叫 10 次、同步耗時約 458 ms。這些時間互有包含，不能相加；這是啟動準備成本。
下一個最小步驟：在獨立回放加入「中心未變就略過 2D jumpTo」的對照，於 CPU／記憶體負載較穩定時重測。正式 Dashboard 與引擎本次都未修改。
